subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall treat a feature draft as ready only when every requirement not covered by FR-14 carries a pass/fail fit criterion and a verification method.
rationale: Structural completeness beyond Must rows, carried over from the planning gate (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-20)
fit_criterion: A draft with one Should requirement lacking a fit criterion, and one lacking a verification method, are each refused naming the requirement.
